excluded_columns.name: transaction_id
excluded_columns.reason: Unique primary key row identifier; non-predictive entity ID

excluded_columns.name: timestamp
excluded_columns.reason: Chronological ordering metadata; represented via temporal features (hour, day, weekend, night)

excluded_columns.name: merchant_id
excluded_columns.reason: Raw high-cardinality entity ID; causes overfitting and memorization instead of behavioral modeling

excluded_columns.name: customer_id
excluded_columns.reason: Raw high-cardinality entity ID; causes overfitting and memorization instead of behavioral modeling

excluded_columns.name: device_id
excluded_columns.reason: Raw high-cardinality entity ID; captured via behavioral features (device_distinct_cust_prev, device_is_new_for_cust)

excluded_columns.name: payment_instrument_id
excluded_columns.reason: Raw high-cardinality entity ID; captured via behavioral features (pi_velocity_count_1h, pi_distinct_cust_prev)

excluded_columns.name: is_fraud
excluded_columns.reason: Observed noisy target label (evaluation/simulation metadata only)

excluded_columns.name: is_fraud_ground_truth
excluded_columns.reason: Primary target variable y; strictly excluded from feature matrix X

excluded_columns.name: fraud_archetype
excluded_columns.reason: Target simulation metadata used only for held-out archetype recall evaluation

excluded_columns.name: fraud_case_id
excluded_columns.reason: Target simulation metadata used only for evaluation
